//: Firestore index source of truth. Deploy with `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`. Single-field equality queries are automatic; composites are listed below.
//ttl: Nonce cleanup is NOT expressed here — Firestore TTL is a field policy, not an index. `challenges.expireAt` must have a TTL policy enabled (see docs/backend/BACKEND_SETUP_GCP.md step A2a: `gcloud firestore fields ttls update expireAt --collection-group=challenges --enable-ttl`), otherwise consumed/expired challenge docs accumulate. consume_nonce deletes on use; TTL reclaims the ones never consumed.

indexes.//: list_licenses_administered_by — a single sign-in page has an address and has to work out whether it belongs to institution IT. array_contains on a repeated field is served by the automatic single-field index; declared anyway so every query in firestore_repo.py has an entry here. kind and status are filtered in Python precisely so this stays a single-clause query and needs no composite.

find_user_by_email — institution IT adds a roster member by email, and seats are keyed by uid. Single equality, which Firestore can serve from automatic single-field indexes; declared anyway so every query in firestore_repo.py has an entry here.

//leases: Floating-seat lease reclaim (_sweep_expired_leases) is a single-field inequality on seats.leaseExpiresAt; Firestore serves that from the automatic single-field index — no composite is required here.
